messages.text: ok it is officially 1:04 am and i just realized the name labels on the phone layout are overflowing if the user has a long last name. why do we have so many users named 'Smith-Jones-Washington'.
add ellipsis. text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap. it's a css fight, not a design fight.
i tried that but the canvas is clipping the bubble weirdly now. also i am eating cold pizza for the third time. send help or snacks.
chinese food on elm is open until 3. chen is driving. get back here in 20 mins.
YES. also the wifi dropped for a sec when i plugged in the charger. do you think the demo laptop is cursed?
check if it's on the 5ghz band. switch to 2.4 if it's flaky. also don't trust the charger, use the dock.
switched. seems fine for now. chen brought dumplings. i love him. back to work in 15.
quick check: is the 'why you connect' modal loading the explanation from cache or hitting qwen3.8? if it's hitting the model, we have a latency risk.
it's reading from the db alias table. no model call unless it's a new string. which it shouldn't be for the demo data.
good. run the demo flow one more time. start with the specific person match, then zoom out to the atlas. under 3 mins?
2 mins 45 secs. i think we are ready. going to sleep for like 4 hours. wake me up at 7:30.
you're on. i'm running the final regression tests on the backend. good luck.
7:32 am. i smell like sleep and stale dumplings. is the db up?
db is up. ollama is warm. nginx is serving https on linkmit.duckdns.org. ready when you are.
ok deep breaths. judges are walking in. i'm shaking a little bit lol. do you want to go first with the tech setup or should i start with the user story?
you start. lead with the 'why' explanation. if they get confused, i'll jump in with the pipeline details. let's go.
they asked about privacy for the third time. chen is handling it. we are still on track. 5 minutes left to wrap up.
we did good. i think we nailed the explanation part. let's hope the judges actually looked at the code.
wait. wait wait wait. chen just walked in with a face that looks like he's seen a ghost or won the lottery. i don't know which one it is.
what. what did he say.
3rd place. dropbox track. we are in 3rd place. i might actually cry in this parking lot.
